Card.Name: Windows PowerShell Script Execution Policy
Card.Description: PowerShell can be configured to block scripts, allow only signed scripts, or allow all scripts. The official policy uses a Group Policy path to control that behavior.
Card.FriendlyDescription: PowerShell can be configured to block scripts, allow only signed scripts, or allow all scripts. The official policy uses a Group Policy path to control that behavior.
Card.WhatWeKnowSummary: Claim: PowerShell can be configured to block scripts, allow only signed scripts, or allow all scripts. The official policy uses a Group Policy path to control that behavior. Evidence: Local official ADMX and ADML files document the exact Group Policy surface under Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\PowerShell using EnableScripts and ExecutionPolicy, and the app now writes those documented values.
